Project Story

Some of our best opportunities begin with simply letting people know we are willing to help.

After receiving one of our "We Buy Houses" mailers distributed throughout Hillsdale, the homeowner contacted us. She was experiencing significant financial hardship, the home had deteriorated over many years, and its condition prevented her from obtaining homeowners insurance.

Rather than seeing a property beyond repair, we saw an opportunity to solve a difficult situation while preserving another home for the Hillsdale community.

Following the purchase, we completed a comprehensive renovation focused on long-term ownership. Today, the property is professionally managed, fully occupied, and provides quality housing for a local family.

The BRRRR Process

B Buy

This property was acquired through our direct mail marketing campaign. After receiving one of our "We Buy Houses" brochures, the homeowner contacted us seeking a solution for a property that had become difficult to maintain.

Because we specialize in value-add investments, we were able to move quickly and purchase the home directly.

R Rehab

Approximately $81,000 was invested to completely transform the property.

The renovation included structural and deferred maintenance repairs, new drywall throughout, new flooring, a completely renovated kitchen, an updated bathroom, new lighting and fixtures, interior and exterior paint, updated mechanical systems, and landscaping and exterior improvements.

Rather than applying cosmetic upgrades, the goal was to create a durable, low-maintenance home that would perform well for years to come.

R Rent

Following completion, the property was professionally leased for $1,975 per month.

Our goal is not simply to renovate homes. It is to provide housing that tenants are proud to call home.

R Refinance

After stabilization, the property appraised for $287,000, creating approximately $148,500 in equity.

The refinance allowed us to recover a significant portion of our invested capital while retaining ownership of the property and continuing to build long-term wealth through rental income.

R Repeat

Capital returned through refinancing was reinvested into additional acquisitions, allowing us to continue expanding our portfolio while preserving quality housing throughout Hillsdale.

Before & After

Front Exterior

Before After ↔

The brick chimney and full-width front porch anchor both frames. Structural and deferred maintenance repairs, interior and exterior paint, and landscaping and exterior improvements brought the outside of the home back.

Rear Deck

Before After ↔

The rear of the home, where the aging covered deck stood. Glass french doors now open onto a fresh deck, part of the exterior improvements that reached every side of the property.

Bedroom

Before After ↔

Water-stained ceilings and decades of wear gave way to new drywall throughout, new flooring, new lighting and fixtures, and fresh paint, the same standard carried through every room of the house.

Lessons Learned

  • Off-market opportunities often come through consistent outreach and strong community relationships.
  • Solving structural and mechanical issues before cosmetic improvements creates better long-term outcomes.
  • Standardizing materials and finishes improves efficiency while reducing future maintenance costs.

Community Impact

  • Preserved a home that was at risk of continued deterioration.
  • Helped a homeowner navigate a difficult financial situation through a direct purchase.
  • Added another professionally managed rental home to the Hillsdale community.
  • Improved the appearance and long-term stability of the surrounding neighborhood.
  • Created quality housing for people who moved from out of town to Hillsdale thanks to the new high-quality supply.
